angle: Liverpool's club-record £116m signing scores twice as Jürgen Klopp's Germany, knocked out of the World Cup by Paraguay in the summer, thrash the Netherlands 5-0.
why_now: Trending on r/LiverpoolFC (trends 2026-11-17, Reddit digest failed again on 2026-11-18 with 404): Wirtz's goals for Klopp's Germany v Netherlands on 16 Nov 2026. Reddit is signal only; every fact below is from trusted outlets.
open_loop: Florian Wirtz cost Liverpool £116m. For Jürgen Klopp's Germany: two goals, five-nil over the Dutch. How did a team knocked out of the World Cup by Paraguay get here?

beats.fact: Florian Wirtz scored twice (60', 71') as Jürgen Klopp's Germany beat the Netherlands 5-0 in Berlin on Monday 16 November 2026. Wirtz joined Liverpool from Bayer Leverkusen in June 2025 for a club record £116m (£100m guaranteed plus £16m in add-ons).
Beat 1 surprise: five months earlier Germany were knocked out of the 2026 World Cup in the round of 32 by Paraguay. Klopp then replaced Julian Nagelsmann as Germany coach.

Klopp on the mood he inherited: over the summer, he said, it felt like the new coach would have to drink himself into a stupor just to look at the German national team - 'But then I arrived, and it was love at first sight.'
beats.quote: Over the summer, it felt as though the new coach -- that's me -- would have to drink himself into a stupor just to be able to look at the German national team. But then I arrived, and it was love at first sight.

beats.fact: Wirtz's first: on the hour he won the ball back from Netherlands captain Denzel Dumfries and fired in off the left post from outside the box. His second: in the 71st minute from a Brajan Gruda cut-back. Gruda scored one and set up two.

The 5-0 took Germany to the top of their Nations League group and into the quarter-finals as group winners; the Netherlands also qualified, in second. Klopp: no-one will be questioning the German national team for the next three or four months.
beats.quote: Everyone will go home with a smile on their face – and for at least the next three or four months, no-one will be questioning the German national team.

quotes.text: Over the summer, it felt as though the new coach -- that's me -- would have to drink himself into a stupor just to be able to look at the German national team. But then I arrived, and it was love at first sight. If we can get our highly talented players firing on all cylinders, then playing against us won't be any fun at all.
